name: Alyosha
title: Swift-Striding Hound
description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

passives.name: Awakened by the Baying Hounds
passives.descriptionRaw: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.
passives.description: When **Tugarin** attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.

passives.name: Suffer the Winter Wheat Will
passives.descriptionRaw: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.
passives.description: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.

passives.name: Into the Fray
passives.descriptionRaw:
Alyosha will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained when the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by the character when on the field by 20%.
passives.description:
Alyosha will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when inside a **Polestar Field**.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Hunter's Precision effect obtained when the **Hunter's Mark** is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by the character when on the field by 20%.

passives.name: Treetop Watch
passives.descriptionRaw: Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Snezhnaya</color> on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Snezhnaya on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.

combatTalents.name: Skirmishing Spear
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to the opponent hit by the final strike.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
combatTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the **Hunter's Mark** to the opponent hit by the final strike.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

combatTalents.name: Thunderbolt Strike
combatTalents.descriptionRaw: Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the {LINK#N11480001}Hunter's Mark{/LINK} effect to the hit opponents. Tapping Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Holding Enters aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode. At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents. The reckless hunter once reached for the spear's edge, and it was only after they survived a lesson paid in blood that they came to understand the harsh truths of survival on the frozen plains.
combatTalents.description:
Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the **Hunter's Mark** effect to the hit opponents.

Tapping
Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG.

Holding
Enters aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode.
At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents.
combatTalents.flavorText: The reckless hunter once reached for the spear's edge, and it was only after they survived a lesson paid in blood that they came to understand the harsh truths of survival on the frozen plains.

combatTalents.name: Hunter's Advance
combatTalents.descriptionRaw: Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time. Fulgurite Hunting Field · Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack. · Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that enters the field. Tugarin · If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG. · If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated. · Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first. Wait. Keep waiting until the impatience fades. That's when the red-bellied plover shall sweep across the birch grove and present itself before one's arrow.
combatTalents.description:
Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time.

Fulgurite Hunting Field
· Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack.
· Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that enters the field.

Tugarin
· If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG.
· If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated.
· Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first.
combatTalents.flavorText: Wait. Keep waiting until the impatience fades. That's when the red-bellied plover shall sweep across the birch grove and present itself before one's arrow.

constellations.name: Frostvale Thunderclap
constellations.descriptionRaw: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
constellations.description: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an Electro-related reaction on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

constellations.name: Howl From Afar
constellations.descriptionRaw:
The duration of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> is extended by 6s.
Additionally, each time {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks the opponent, he will also apply the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to a target. This effect does not activate existing <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Marks</color>.

constellations.name: Standard Reclaimed
constellations.descriptionRaw: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained from activating a {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100 if they are on the field.
